source.file: MUH050226 Infinity - Yu Jing Faction Book.pdf
source.authority: Faction-book Yu Jing character-creation entries supersede their Corebook counterparts when its variant Lifepath rules are used.

homeworld_relationship.correction: Replaces the previous generic Yu Jing homeworld string that included Earth and omitted Paradiso and Human Edge.

careers.note: The unified Career dropdown now exposes these source careers. The current sheet does not automate Lifepath hazard rolls or era-dependent defection/status changes.

equipment_coverage.source_reference_only_records: Vehicles, remotes, and other non-personal-loadout records are retained in the database but marked loadoutEligible=false so normal/random equipment selection does not treat them as carried personal gear.
equipment_coverage.armour_convention: Existing sheet convention remains Light 5 / Medium 10 / Heavy or powered 15. Exact sourcebook Armour/BTS values are preserved in each item's Rules/Notes text.
equipment_coverage.rarity_mapping: The sourcebook uses Restriction ratings rather than the sheet's Common/Uncommon/Rare vocabulary. For display only, Restriction 1–5 is mapped to Common/Uncommon/Rare/Very Rare/Legendary. Variable or variant-only entries remain Variable/Restricted-style source references rather than inventing a rating.
equipment_coverage.x_visor_correction: Updated to the sourcebook effect: ignore one Difficulty worth of range penalties on Ballistics or Observation tests.

deliberate_nonconversions: Yu Jing adolescent/heritage event traits were not converted into the sheet's custom skill-bonus Trait model because the sourcebook treats them as narrative Lifepath traits and event outcomes, not as the custom primary/secondary-skill mechanics used by this sheet.

Full random Lifepath event generation, social-status UI, heritage UI, and era-dependent Japanese Uprising logic were not added because the current character sheet has no corresponding fields/workflow.
No source gaps were silently filled with invented rules; where a source value is variant-only or not priced as ordinary personal equipment, the record is marked accordingly.
